notes: Excerpt of the 2026 Annual Budget: printed pages 136-180 of 424 (32 scanned pages). Printed pages 147, 151-152, 161-166, 169, 172, 175 and 178 are not in the scan; every office's printed totals are nevertheless present and its transcribed line items add up to them, so the missing pages appear to be non-tabular (e.g. office narrative/profile) pages.

Offices in order: Register of Deeds (p.136), Office of the Police (pp.137-139), People's Law Enforcement Board (p.140), Fire and Safety Services (p.141), Department of Education (pp.142-143), Lapu-Lapu City College (pp.144-146), City Health Officer (pp.148-150), PESO (pp.153-154), City Social Welfare and Development Center with its Special Purpose Appropriations (pp.155-160), City Veterinarian (pp.167-168), CENRO (pp.170-171), City Engineer (pp.173-174), City Tourism (pp.176-177), Local Economic Development & Promotion Office (pp.179-180). Signatories differ per office; each office head who prepared a form is listed in certifiedBy.

Columns: 2024 Past Year Actual, 2025 First Semester Actual, 2025 Second Semester Estimates, 2025 Total, 2026 Budget Year Proposed. Amounts in full pesos. The City Health Officer pages print the column headings as '2024 Actual', 'Actual', 'Estimates', 'Total', '2026 Proposed'; same layout.
Account codes are transcribed as printed (stray spaces removed); codes printed with a leading dash carry the fund/office prefix of the first code in the block.

Office of the Police: printed pages 138-139 break down the 2024 Past Year Actual of 'Other Professional Services - Police' by program (Crime Prevention, Law Enforcement, Internal Security, Counter Terrorism, Environmental Protection, Drug Affectation, Prosecution and Courts; 12,432,000.00 in total, past-year column only) and end with a Grand Total (2024: 21,825,093.69) that equals the page-137 TOTAL (9,393,093.69) plus these program totals. They are kept in table 'office-of-the-police-programs', whose first row repeats the page-137 TOTAL so that the printed Grand Total can be checked; summary.offices uses the page-137 office TOTAL (2026 proposed 27,284,000.00, same in both).

City Social Welfare and Development Center: the office block (TOTAL 185,364,853.00 proposed) is followed by Special Purpose Appropriation blocks transcribed as separate tables: Senior Citizens, Gender & Development Office, Operation of Homecare Center, Stimulation and Therapeutic Activity Center (STAC), Person w/ Disability Affairs Office (PDAO) and Solo Parent Welfare Program. The printed GRAND TOTAL on page 159 (2026 proposed 470,313,353.00) is kept in table 'cswdc-grand-total'; it equals the sum of the seven block totals in every column.
PESO (Public Employment Services Office) and the Local Economic Development & Promotion Office print only 2026 Budget Year Proposed amounts (past-year and 2025 columns blank, recorded as null).

Blank 2026 Budget Year Proposed cells (e.g. most Capital Outlay lines, CSWDC 'Honorarium for Day Care', Senior Citizens 'Traveling Expenses - Local') are recorded as null; printed dashes as 0. Where a Capital Outlay sub-total has no 2026 amount, summary.offices.capitalOutlay is null (blank) or 0 (dash) as printed.
All printed sub-totals, totals and grand totals agree with the sum of their line items in every column (no arithmetic inconsistencies found).
